title: Discovery only
description: Write only discovery.json, a report of collections, brands, and themes with their overrides. Use it to inspect the design system structure. No Dart files are generated.

title: Dark theme name
description: Display name of the dark themes. The root theme is matched by codeName `dark` first; brand themes share this name.

title: Light theme name
description: Display name of the light themes. The root theme is matched by codeName `light` first; brand themes share this name.
